name: procore-xer-fixer
description: Fix XER files that come from Oracle Primavera Cloud so that they can be imported into Procore's New Schedule Tool

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

commands.name: xer-fixer
commands.title: XER Fixer
commands.description: Fix selected .xer for Procore (writes to fixed-xer folder next to the file)
commands.subtitle: Fix the XER for Procore

title: Procore XER Fixer
author: daniel_soliman
